title: Fixed-wing model
current_gap: Fixed-wing model source, control stack/actuators and flight conditions are missing; ArduCopter must not be forced to control a fixed-wing.

atoms.name: model_source
atoms.required: Pinned fixed-wing model source with airfoil/aerodynamic parameters

atoms.name: control_stack_actuators
atoms.required: Declared control stack (e.g. ArduPlane-class) and actuator set: aileron/elevator/rudder/throttle

atoms.name: flight_conditions
atoms.required: Fixed-wing flight conditions (airspeed, stall, coordinated turn) with expected responses

atoms.name: no_forced_arducopter
atoms.required: Rule enforced: ArduCopter is never wired to control a fixed-wing

scope_rule: a multicopter stack is never a fixed-wing controller; lift/stall semantics belong to the fixed-wing model

followups.blocked_by: Model source and control stack decision

preserved.shared_row: MODEL-07 row also covers the compound wing under #141
